audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[] side disagreed with content win[] on 5 of 7 rows — full read all 'Skill' through level 6 then 'Skill' again on first item; content says Zilean wins L1 through L4-5, Skill at L6, and Sona from first item on. Full-layer breakdown fields were generic template prose with no real ability names.
audit.why: Content's reasoning is grounded in real kit facts: Zilean's bomb poke outranges Sona's Aria early and his double-bomb (Q reset by E) stun makes him the aggressor through level 5; Chronoshift saves one target but adds no lane pressure so level 6 is a genuine skill fight; Sona's sustain-and-aura package then out-scales his static poke once items land. That matches Zilean's actual pattern; full-layer text was templated filler.
audit.corrected: Rewrote phases[0-3].side to 'Zilean' and phases[5].side to 'Sona' (phases[4] and phases[6] already matched content, so only their why fields were rewritten), rewrote each why with the grounded reasoning (no content win[] edits needed, it was already correct), and rewrote breakdown.early/mid/cooldowns/trading/feeding/carry/late, ahead, tradeGood, tradeBad, enemyWin, and loading using real ability names (Chronoshift, the double-bomb Q-E stun, Aria of Perseverance, Power Chord, Crescendo).

audit.why: The level-6 Chronoshift-vs-Crescendo skill window and first-item swing to Sona's sustain-and-aura package are now correctly reflected in the rewritten phases and breakdown.carry/late.

edits.before: - Zilean Chronoshift: matchup-defining — The revive undoes your kill — force it early or swap focus when it glows. It writes your spacing rules. - E Song of Celerity is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: Chronoshift (R) revives whoever it is cast on for a few seconds — burn your damage before it glows blue, or swap focus once it does. His double-Q stun needs E to reset the bomb, so only trade in that reset downtime, never into a loaded second Q.

edits.before: Good trade: Q-chord the pair at aura edge, W the trade-back, walk — invisible margins, compounding ledger. Bad trade: Chord-greeding inside a hook champion's range — the squishiest support in the game has no second chances.
edits.after: Good trade: chip him in his double-bomb downtime, sustain with Aria, and never overextend into a pending stun window. Bad trade: stepping up for a Power Chord poke while his E-reset second Q is still live and armed.

edits.before: - Sona vs Zilean - Track: Zilean Chronoshift. - Track his engage cooldown — your duo trades only when it's down. - Chronoshift spent means windows open. - Keep the ult for the swing moment.
